title: Retention distribution for product noise
statement: Let $\rho\in[0,1]$. The product-noise retention distribution is a probability mass function on $\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ that assigns probability $p$ to retaining a coordinate and probability $1-p$ to not retaining it, where $p$ is the nonnegative-correlation probability associated with $\rho$.
caveat: The definition of the nonnegative-correlation probability is not included, so its formula as a function of $\rho$ cannot be stated here.
